sentence: This project studies what a protein called Plvap and its related structures do in glomerular endothelial cells when they are injured.
This project builds an imaging technique to give clear pictures of the drugs used in cancer radionuclide therapy.
This project studies a type of cortical neuron that responds to serotonin and acetylcholine and releases both an excitatory and an inhibitory neurotransmitter.
This project studies whether Alzheimer's disease patients and mouse models make natural antibodies and immune responses against brain aggregates.
This project supports research on the DNA damage response and oncogenic signaling in cancer biology.
This project compares brain cells grown from patients who have a protein mutation with cells from healthy people to find out why epilepsy develops.
This project studies the immune cells behind resistance to current cancer immunotherapies.
This project tries to find out how expression control tools work so that better ones can be designed.
This project studies how neuropeptides are packaged and released from terminals and the soma, and how this controls rhythmic behaviors, pain, appetite and mood.
This project studies how lipid metabolism in arcuate melanocortin neurons controls feeding behavior and energy metabolism.
This project develops a gene editing therapy for glioblastoma that targets a molecule glioma growth depends on.
This project builds genomic tools to find repeat expansions that cause human disease.
This project supports the use of human factors principles to turn research on aging into devices, interventions and programs for older adults.
This project uses stem cell models to rebuild early placental villi in vitro to study how the human placenta develops.
This project tests whether adipose-derived stem cells can be used to study how human cytomegalovirus stays latent.
This project studies why T cells respond to only a few tumor antigens and tests ways to get broader T cell responses against cancer.
This project provides liquid handling machines, plate readers and libraries that let researchers screen many samples for cancer-related questions.
This project provides digital pathology and genomics tools, including DNA methylation analysis and spatial transcriptomics, to study changes from inflammation to cancer in the prostate.
This project focuses on translational research in environmental health sciences.
